title: Get Others to Do the Work for You, but Always Take the Credit
coreMove: Separate contribution from remembered ownership so the visible result attaches to you
sourcePressure: using other people's labor, knowledge, or effort while securing visible ownership of the result, and the political difference between hidden contribution and remembered authorship.
